title: Artaxerxes sends Nehemiah to rebuild Jerusalem, Nisan of his twentieth year (Neh 2:1–8)
summary: In Nisan of Artaxerxes' twentieth year his cupbearer Nehemiah asks to be sent to Judah to build the city of his fathers' tombs; the king grants letters for safe passage and timber for the gates, the wall and a house.
external_reason: Candidate starting point for Dan 9:25 (Africanus; Anderson; Guzik).

mentions.notes: Chislev "in the twentieth year" precedes Nisan of the twentieth year.

scripture_extraction.reason: External to Daniel: researched as a candidate starting point of Dan 9:25; Nehemiah is not yet extracted chapter by chapter.
